layered_memory.write_*
вызывается напрямую.
Нет atomic commit.
Три файла — три риска.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ChatTurnRequest
├─ actions: str
├─ campaign_id: str
└─ player_name: str

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
_run_pipeline()
Шаг 1: Загрузка
• scene_state: dict
• npc_raw: list[dict]
• player_state: dict
• _load_npcs_with_runtime()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Шаг 2: LifeEngine + Economy
• _life_engine.tick()
• EconomyTracker.tick()
• WorldTickEngine.should_tick()
→ world_tick_meta: dict

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Шаг 3: ContextBuilder
• build_context()
→ PipelineContext
├─ scene_state
├─ npc_contexts: list
├─ player_target_id
└─ ... 30 полей

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Шаг 4: NPC-цикл (for each npc)
├─ load_profile_from_legacy_json → NPCPersonality
├─ load_l2_state_from_runtime_dict → NPCState
├─ StateApplicator.apply_physical (если удар)
├─ ReflexResolver → SceneEvents
├─ ConditionEngine.tick()
├─ MemoryManager.get_weights_for_decision()
├─ CognitiveDistortionEngine
├─ DecisionHub.compute() → DecisionResult
├─ StateApplicator.apply() → NPCState (новый)
├─ MemoryManager.create_event_memory()
├─ ReactionResolver → MicroEvents
└─ npc_contexts.append({...})

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Шаг 5: Post-NPC
├─ WorldTickEngine.compute_proactive_decisions()
│ → WorldTickResult (List[dict] НЕ EventDTO!)
├─ SocialPropagation
├─ PerceptionFilter
└─ DM агент → dm_result

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Шаг 6: Persistence
├─ _write_memory() → layered_memory.write_campaign_memory
├─ record_event() → working_memory
├─ run_decay_if_needed()
├─ detect_resonance()
└─ apply_identity_weights()

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Шаг 7: Output\n→ _PipelineState\n→ ChatTurnResponse / SSE

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 1: InputAdapter
ChatTurnRequest
 ↓
 EventDTO
├─ type: PLAYER_ACTION
├─ source: player_name
├─ payload: {actions}
└─ visibility: public

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 2: EventBus (primary)
event_bus.publish(event)
→ все подписчики
синхронно

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 3: MemoryProcessor
MemoryProcessor.apply(
 event: EventDTO,
 npc_state: NPCState
)
→ оценка:
 • importance
 • emotion
 • relation_delta
→ обновлённый NPCState
(ДО DecisionHub!)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 4: TopicExtractor
Читает:
• STM (DialogueSession)
• L2 (narrative_cache)
• Ключевые слова из event
→ topic: str
'торговля_мечом'

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 5: DecisionHub
DecisionHub.compute(
 topic: str, ← из TopicExtractor
 state: NPCState, ← свежий из фазы 3
 identity: IdentityL1,
 relations: dict
)
→ DecisionResult
→ CommunicationIntent
├─ audience
├─ topic (не пустой!)
└─ exposure_level

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 6: IntentEventAdapter
CommunicationIntent
 ↓
 EventDTO
├─ type: NPC_SPOKE
├─ source: npc_id
├─ visibility: exposure.semantic
└─ radius: exposure.physical
Никаких List[dict]!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ФАЗА 7: EventBus (secondary)\nevent_bus.publish(npc_event)\n→ другие NPC реагируют

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 8: Handlers
• memory_manager.handle()
• social_engine.handle()
• scene_state_manager.handle()
• reaction_resolver.handle()
Явные подписки.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 9: WorldSnapshotBuilder
Reducer: события → state
→ WorldSnapshotDTO
├─ positions
├─ visible_npcs
├─ recent_events
└─ available_actions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
ФАЗА 10: PersistencePort
SQLite — atomic commit
YAML — snapshot/export
→ frontend получает
 WorldSnapshotDTO
